display_description.he: ניהול משלוחים ומעקב חבילות מול שלדנים ישראליים — דואר ישראל, צ'יטה, HFD, בלדר, מהיר לי ונקודות BOX
display_description.en: Manage shipping operations across Israeli carriers — Israel Post, Cheetah, HFD, Baldar, Mahir Li, and BOX pickup points. Use when user asks about "shipping Israel", "Israel Post API", "Cheetah delivery", "meshloach", "shipping label", "package tracking Israel", "BOX pickup", "HFD", "Baldar", or "tawit mishloach". Covers carrier selection, Israeli address formatting, label generation, cross-carrier tracking, and customer delivery notifications. Do NOT use for international shipping outside Israel or customs/import.
